description:
Sixth item in the CI-waste sequence. After remesure and overlap inventory exist, choose exactly one outcome: KEEP_IDLE (no skip, no shard, no engine-sample rotation, no PR-vs-queue event split, no post-merge slow lane) or OPEN_ONE_FOLLOWUP (create exactly one new tracker item with its own decision record).

This item does not implement skips. Engine-sample rotation, PR vs merge_group event split, medium/correctness sharding, Hypothesis expansion, mutation testing as a PR job, and a post-merge slow lane stay idle unless OPEN_ONE_FOLLOWUP names one of them and cites required-ci-coverage-deepest-reproducers if that one is a slow lane.

anti_patterns.why: this is a gate, not a rollout
